name: @ocr2md/mopjo
description: Standalone MOPJO immutable document IR, operations and PDF/Markdown projection

scripts.test: npm run verify:boundary && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:buffett && npm run test:wp3 && npm run test:wp4 && npm run test:wp5
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop --types node --target ES2022 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node src/core.ts src/cli.ts src/operations.ts src/elements.ts src/chapters.ts src/chapterCli.ts src/chapterV4Ops.ts src/chapterLocate.ts src/chapterSegments.ts tests/roundtrip.test.ts tests/realBookReadOnly.test.ts tests/buffettWp2.test.ts tests/buffettWp3.test.ts tests/buffettWp4.test.ts tests/buffettWp4Cli.test.ts src/v4Port.ts tests/buffettWp5.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && esbuild tests/roundtrip.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/roundtrip.test.mjs && node dist/roundtrip.test.mjs
scripts.test:buffett: npm run build && npm run build:buffett-test && bash tests/run-buffett-wp2.sh
scripts.test:wp3: npm run build && npm run build:wp3-test && bash tests/run-buffett-wp3.sh
scripts.test:wp4: npm run build && npm run build:wp4-test && bash tests/run-buffett-wp4.sh
scripts.test:wp5: npm run build:port && npm run build:wp5-test && bash tests/run-buffett-wp5.sh && node -e "import('./dist/v4Port.mjs').then(x => {if(!x.MopjoV4ChapterSession || x.MOPJO_V4_PORT_VERSION !== 1) process.exit(2);console.log('MOPJO_WP5_PORT_BUNDLE_OK')})"
